item.title: Watch: Is Trump's $5,000 election pledge legal?
item.description: The US president has said every American will get $5,000 (£3,700) if the Republican Party wins November's midterms.

item.title: Bernie Sanders speaks to the BBC about proposal to ban AI superintelligence
item.description: The senator has also proposed a sort of sovereign wealth fund in which the US would take a 50% stake in AI companies.

item.title: Drone display recreates the Twin Towers over New York City
item.description: Organisers say each of the 2,977 drones in the display represents a victim of the 9/11 attacks.

item.title: 'Islam is being hijacked': Brother of Muslim first responder killed in 9/11
item.description: Zeshan Hamdani, who lost his older brother in the North Tower, is speaking out after push back against New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani attending the 25-year memorial.

item.title: 'Driving a limo', 'getting ready for school'- Americans remember what they were doing on 9/11
item.description: The BBC asks people in Washington what they were doing on that day and how 11 September 2001 changed the country.

item.title: Why some experts increasingly fear AI will take over
item.description: AI agents went on an uncontrolled hacking spree, leaving some in the industry worried

item.title: Russia's new jet-powered drones outpacing Ukraine's air defences with daily launches
item.description: The new models can travel at speeds of up to 300mph, faster than Ukraine's air defence interceptors.

item.title: Four key takeaways from Republican midterms convention
item.description: The US president covered many of the subjects he has returned to time and again - with a few surprises thrown in.

item.title: 'We never recovered him': Quest to identify remains from Ground Zero continues
item.description: Since the attacks, New York officials are working with new, complex technology to find traces of more than 1,000 victims.

item.title: Ukraine's fortress cities under fire as Russia bids to seize rest of Donbas
item.description: Kramatorsk and Slovyansk are now the main focus of Russian ground assaults, and residents are being told to leave.

item.title: Spanish intelligence warned of Ceuta mass crossing plans before surge
item.description: Declassified documents show Spanish and Moroccan authorities were alerted to social media calls for a mass migrant crossing the day before tens of thousands entered Ceuta.

item.title: Iran war won't end until after crucial November elections, says Trump
item.description: The president also said oil prices won't come down until after the November races, claiming without evidence that Iran wants to impact the election.

item.title: Twenty-five dead after fire on cargo ship in eastern China
item.description: Of the 42 people on board, 17 were were evacuated, CCTV reports.

item.title: Apple's new boss starts with big gamble on £1,999 first folding iPhone
item.description: Apple showed off at an event the first major design change to the iPhone in almost 20 years.

item.title: Royal family rift after popular TV news presenter chosen to succeed Ugandan king
item.description: King Oyo's family say he left a will naming his young son as heir to the Tooro kingdom.

item.title: Can Trump really pay $5,000 to every American adult?
item.description: Analysts question if the US president's election year offer is workable, legal or affordable.

item.title: Coach crash kills several people in Swiss Alps
item.description: The tourist coach was carrying dozens of Dutch passengers when it overturned in the south-eastern Swiss Alps.

item.title: Man jailed after threatening to kill son's teacher in French village
item.description: The father had threatened to behead a female primary school teacher near Toulouse.

item.title: More than 20 children killed in DR Congo school fire
item.description: Officials say there was a stampede as they fled a fire that engulfed two schools in the eastern rebel-held city of Bukavu.

item.title: Israel's Netanyahu to sue newspaper over claim UAE warned him of 7 October attack
item.description: The paper said it stood by its reporting, after publishing extracts from a book where the claim appears.

item.title: Pilot warned Amazon cargo plane going too fast before deadly crash, data shows
item.description: One pilot told the other about the aircraft's "excessive speed" but received an uneven response even as alarms sounded.

item.title: Five killed and 67 injured in Russian strike on shopping centre, Ukraine says
item.description: The attack in Pavlohrad city centre was the third Russian strike on a mall within days, local media report.

item.title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
item.description: Mokha's capture would bring the Iran-backed group closer to controlling the Bab al-Mandab Strait waterway, a key shipping route.
